docs.title: Tabla Beginner Lessons
docs.text:
A practice companion for the beginner curriculum: four semesters of exercises, kaaydas, relas, and tukdas. Every composition is written out in bols — the spoken syllables of the drum — with a demonstration video wherever one has been recorded. Recite along, then play.

Semester 01Foundations Semester 02Relas & kaaydas Semester 03Speed & control Semester 04Composition

docs.title: How to practise
docs.text:
Recite the bols aloud with a hand-clap before you play them. Keep tere kete inside the black gaab at the centre of the drum, and let the left-hand fingers rest on the edge. Take one palta at a time.

  1. Relax the hand
  2. Correct the shoulder posture
  3. Recite with a hand-clap
  4. Left-hand fingers touch the edge
  5. Tere kete stays within the black gaab
  6. Beginners play straight tete only — no reverse tete
  7. No more than three paltas in an hour

docs.title: For teachers
docs.text:
• Check the student has a tabla set and has registered for the term.
  • Ask students to bring a composition notebook for their own notation.
  • Keep classes to a maximum of eight students.
  • Assess each student's level individually, practise as a group, then have every student play alone in class.
